abstract: A unique electrophoretic form of lactate dehydrogenase (LDH-Z), formerly observed in a choriocarcinoma cell line (JEG-3) and first-trimester placenta, has been shown to be the same as that produced in hydatidiform mole and term placenta. We have also observed LDH-Z in second-trimester placenta, choriocarcinoma metastasized to the liver, and five of five additional independently derived (from different patients) choriocarcinoma cell lines. The only exception to the production of LDH-Z in a choriocarcinoma was in the cell line BEWO, which was established from the same tumor as JEG-3. Since BEWO has been in culture for over 200 passages more than any of the independently derived lines, its lack of LDH-Z is viewed as being consistent with the loss of certain expressional characteristics upon such long-term culture. Analysis of JEG-3 subclones revealed the expression of LDH-Z to be independent of the products of the LDH-A genetic locus. Present data do not allow us to determine whether LDH-Z is the product of a newly discovered LDH locus or is a modified form of the product of the LDH-B locus. LDH-Z has not been observed in other human tissues, nor have we observed it in homogenates prepared from over 60 cell lines established from a wide variety of human neoplasms. We therefore conclude that LDH-Z is an isozyme associated with human choriocarcinoma and is indicative of the trophoblastic origin of the cells.
abstract_ja: 乳酸脱水素酵素（LDH）の特殊な電気泳動型であるLDH-Zは、以前に絨毛癌細胞株（JEG-3）および妊娠初期の胎盤で観察されていた。本研究では、LDH-Zが胞状奇胎および正期胎盤でも産生されることを示す。さらに、妊娠中期の胎盤、肝転移を起こした絨毛癌、ならびに別の患者から樹立された5株の絨毛癌細胞株においてもLDH-Zを観察した。例外は、JEG-3と同一腫瘍から樹立されたBEWO株であり、200継代以上の長期培養によりこの特性が失われたと考えられる。JEG-3のサブクローン解析により、LDH-Zの発現はLDH-A遺伝子座の産物とは無関係であることが示された。LDH-Zが新規のLDH遺伝子座の産物か、LDH-B遺伝子座産物の修飾体かは決定できなかった。LDH-Zは他のヒト組織では観察されず、ヒトのさまざまな腫瘍由来の60以上の細胞株のホモジネートにも認められなかった。したがって、LDH-Zは絨毛癌に関連するアイソザイムであり、細胞の栄養膜由来を示すものと結論する。
